# Velnora

> AI-powered web development agency. Velnora designs and builds high-performance
> websites, AI-powered digital solutions, and SEO strategies for growing businesses.

Velnora is a single-page marketing site (velnora.com) covering the company's
services, process, portfolio, and contact channels. Content on the page is
plain HTML/DOM (not canvas-only), so it can be read directly.

## Services

- Website Development — custom-built websites on modern frameworks, structured
  around how customers decide to buy, book, or get in touch.
- AI-Powered Solutions — AI-assisted search, content, and support tooling
  layered into a site to reduce routine inbound questions.
- SEO — technical SEO, content structure, and on-page fundamentals built in
  from the start.
- UI/UX Design — interface and interaction design grounded in real user flows.
- Website Optimization — performance audits and fixes across images, scripts,
  and hosting.
- Business Automation — workflow automation connecting forms, inbox, and
  scheduling.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.velnora.com/): services, process, portfolio ("Selected
  Work" — a mix of real client projects and clearly labeled concept projects),
  client reviews, and a contact form.

## Contact

- Contact form on the homepage (`#contact`), or email via the address listed
  in the site footer.

## Notes for crawlers

- `/admin` and `/internal/*` are internal tooling, not public content —
  excluded via robots.txt and not part of the site's marketing content.
